title: Mean of the empty restricted Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $\delta\in\mathbb R$. The average over random coordinate restrictions, with each subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ weighted by $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$ and the signs outside $J$ chosen uniformly, of the empty-set Fourier coefficient of the restricted function equals the empty-set Fourier coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
